claims.claim: A /gsd-autonomous mission whose final budgeted turn completes the milestone ends COMPLETED, not HALTED
evidence: V-MC-CONVERGE-AT-BUDGET-COMPLETES red on HEAD, green after
counterevidence: no live mission has reached ALL_COMPLETE yet: 0 of 43 COMPLETED; the path is REACHABLE (sweep runs repo file) but not EXERCISED live

claims.falsified_by: a torn mission record after a process kill

claims.claim: fsync before rename makes the record durable across power loss / bugcheck
counterevidence: process kill does not exercise it: the OS cache survives; needs a power-loss plane

evidence: mutation lock+unlock removed killed by 2 gates

claims.claim: A ledger row lost for a mission transition is detectable as a named gap
counterevidence: history before the first numbered transition is unjudged

claims.claim: Relay and renewal require measured progress; 3 unchanged epochs halt no_progress
evidence: fingerprint stable/moving on a real repo; measured on KobiiCraft ~15 s
counterevidence: commits are a lower bound on progress, not semantic progress
no live no_progress halt observed yet
claims.falsified_by: a live lineage renewed with an unchanged tree, or a progressing mission halted no_progress

claims.claim: The sweep runs one pass at a time, bounds each stage with a tree kill, and heartbeats every pass
evidence: live heartbeat ran: mission rc 0 193.7 s, v2 rc 0 35.8 s
counterevidence: mixed old/new pass overlap possible for the one pass straddling the commit
claims.falsified_by: two concurrent sweep processes, or a stage outliving its deadline

claims.claim: Every mission decision names the build that made it; a newer-schema record is refused
claims.falsified_by: a ledger row with no code=, or an older build writing a newer record

claims.claim: This pass's invariants did not require a Goal Spine connection

counterevidence: commit-based progress cannot see semantic regress or research epochs
